skill_name: Write a horror story involving a phone call.
workflow: The night was dark and the wind was howling. Rachel was alone in her house, the only sound in the air was the ticking of the clock, painfully loud in the eerie silence. All of a sudden, her phone rang, breaking the thick silence. Without thinking, Rachel picked up the phone, her heart beating faster. "Hello, who is this?" she asked, her voice shaking.
